proposed.text: What does Section 5-i say about signing and sealing documents?

options.text: Do not sign and seal plans or professional documents prepared outside direct personal supervision.
Sign any plan if the client pays the fee.
Seal contractor-prepared drawings to speed up permitting.
Sign work from any entity if the project is small.

proposed.rationale: Section 5-i prohibits affixing signature and seal to documents prepared by others or entities not under direct personal supervision.
